units.source_text: 说实在的，我没有必要非和K住在一起。

en.t: To tell the truth, I had no real need to live together with K.

units.source_text: 但是我认为，把每月的花费以钱的形式给他的话，他一定会十分为难。

en.t: But I thought that if I gave him the monthly expenses in the form of money, he would surely feel terribly awkward about it.

units.source_text: 因为，他的自立心是如此强烈。

en.t: That was because his sense of independence was so strong.

units.source_text: 把他安置在我的住处，便可以背着他，悄悄把两个人的饭费交给夫人。

en.t: If I settled him at my lodging, I could secretly give the lady of the house the meal expenses for both of us without his knowing.

units.source_text: 但是关于他的经济状况，我并不打算告诉夫人。

en.t: However, I had no intention of telling the lady of the house about his financial situation.

units.source_text: 我只说了些有关K身体的情况，要是再这样孤独下去，他的性情会越发乖僻的。

en.t: I only spoke about K's health, saying that if he went on living in such loneliness, his temperament would become still more eccentric.

units.source_text: 作为补充说明，我把他同养父家闹翻，同父母家脱离关系的情况也一一讲了一遍。

en.t: By way of further explanation, I also told them in detail how he had fallen out with his adoptive family and broken ties with his own parents' home.

units.source_text: 我告诉夫人和小姐，我现在是抱着一个快要淹死的人，怀着将自己的热量传给他的决心带他来的，因此也拜托你们给予他温暖和关心。

en.t: I told the lady and the young woman that I was bringing him there as if I were holding a person about to drown, resolved to pass my own warmth to him, and I asked them as well to give him warmth and care.

units.source_text: 就这样，我终于说服了夫人。

en.t: In this way, I finally persuaded the lady of the house.

units.source_text: 但是，我并没有告诉K，他对这一经过毫不知情。

en.t: But I did not tell K, and he knew nothing at all about this course of events.

units.source_text: 我反而觉得很满足，若无其事地迎接慢吞吞地搬来的K。

en.t: On the contrary, I felt quite satisfied and received K, who moved in slowly and heavily, as if nothing had happened.

units.source_text: 夫人和小姐热情地帮他收拾行李，忙前忙后。

en.t: The lady and the young woman warmly helped him unpack his luggage and busied themselves looking after him.

units.source_text: 我心里暗暗高兴，觉得她们为K所做的这一切都是出于对我的好意，尽管K仍是一副阴沉的面孔。

en.t: Inwardly I was secretly pleased, feeling that everything they did for K came from their kindness toward me, even though K still wore a gloomy expression.
